npm with a lockfile: the overrides section is inserted after the last top-level key.
-- changes --
[
 {"name":"semver","ecosystem":"npm","to":"7.7.2","method":"override","file":"package.json"},
 {"name":"@scope/pkg","ecosystem":"npm","to":"1.2.3","method":"override","file":"package.json"}
]
-- in:package.json --
{
  "name": "app",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "express": "^4.18.0"
  }
}
-- in:package-lock.json --
{}
-- out:package.json --
{
  "name": "app",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "express": "^4.18.0"
  },
  "overrides": {
    "semver": "7.7.2",
    "@scope/pkg": "1.2.3"
  }
}
